capabilities: Find and replace property values across the vault or a base's results
Bulk edit, roll up, and sync formulas into frontmatter properties
Import CSV as notes and export bases or folders to CSV
Color Bases rows and cells with conditional formatting rules
Index and audit vault properties, fix type mismatches, and merge duplicate notes
extras: Runs entirely locally with no network access or telemetry. The README documents CSV export limitations inline and warns that Obsidian's own property-menu forgetting can't be patched, only worked around via the property index.
problem: Obsidian Bases and the properties editor lack bulk editing, vault-wide value replacement, CSV import/export, an always-complete property list, and safe fixing of mistyped property values.

relations.evidence: Reviewing its code later inspired several history refinements here — selective per-file revert, the force-revert option
Opens an editable, spreadsheet-style grid over a folder's notes, using the separate GridSense plugin.
clicking a note in a base that lives in a Stashpad folder opens it in the Stashpad view
converts Dataview inline key:: value fields into frontmatter properties
our conditional formatting instead colors whole rows by explicit rules
our merge adds frontmatter awareness: list union + per-conflict picker
the companion browser tool our CSV import's converter core is ported from

summary: Toolbox for Obsidian Bases and frontmatter properties: bulk edits, vault-wide find & replace, CSV import/export, conditional formatting, and a property index.
